segments.speaker: Secretary Anil
segments.text: The lift in block B has broken down three times this month.

segments.speaker: Treasurer Priya
segments.text: We have budget for either repairs or a full replacement, not both.

segments.speaker: Member Kiran
segments.text: Replacement is safer in the long run.

segments.speaker: Treasurer Priya
segments.text: Actually, wait. Replacement takes four months, and residents need the lift now.

segments.speaker: Member Kiran
segments.text: True. So repair it now and plan the replacement for next financial year?

segments.speaker: Secretary Anil
segments.text: Yes, that's the better plan. Repair now, replacement next year.

segments.speaker: Secretary Anil
segments.text: Kiran, can you get three repair quotes by next Monday?
